name: Wolf

traits.name: Pack Tactics
traits.summary: Advantage on attack rolls against a target that has a non-Incapacitated ally of this creature within 5 ft.
traits.text: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature when at least one of the wolf's allies is within 5 feet of that creature and that ally doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

actions.name: Bite
actions.summary: Bites a target; a Medium or smaller target is knocked Prone.
actions.text: Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is Medium or smaller, it has the Prone condition.

summary: Circles with its pack to gain Advantage, bites to knock prey Prone, then the pack piles on.
